summary: The ansible.builtin.psrp connection plugin runs tasks on Windows over PowerShell Remoting Protocol, using the same transport as winrm but running in a PowerShell interpreter.
questions: What is the difference between psrp and winrm connections?
How else can I connect to Windows hosts besides winrm?

answer_card.title: psrp connection plugin
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.psrp` runs commands and file transfers on Windows via PowerShell Remoting Protocol. It uses the same underlying transport as `winrm`, but runs inside a PowerShell interpreter.
